accepted.sentence: This storage furniture typically has an enclosed frame with interior shelves or compartments behind one or more doors.
Its doors often attach to the frame with hinges, allowing them to swing outward for access to stored items.
Common versions use solid wood, plywood, metal, or combinations of these materials for their panels and structural frame.
Small knobs or pulls are usually fixed to the doors or drawers to make opening them easier.
A thin rear panel can brace the structure and cover the back of its interior compartments.
Some interiors contain movable shelves supported by pins inserted into paired rows of holes along the side walls.
A broad bottom panel supports the stored contents, while legs or a recessed base may raise the frame above the floor.
Wall-mounted versions are secured to studs or masonry, with fasteners carrying the weight of the unit and its contents.
